description_md:
# What You Get

- 
Skill Examples (Bad vs Good): Two complete bad skills and two complete good skills side by side. See exactly what makes a skill fail (vague descriptions, wrong naming, no triggers) versus what makes it work (specific triggers, clear steps, error handling).

- 
Comparison Guides (3 docs): Side-by-side breakdowns of bad vs good descriptions (6 pairs), bad vs good instructions (with templates), and a visual catalog of the 8 most common mistakes with exact fixes.

- 
Excalidraw Canvas: All 9 diagrams from the video arranged on a single canvas with arrows between sections. Import into Excalidraw for presentations or reference.
